title: Jawa 42 Bobber Black Mirror (Classic Heritage)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Jawa Motorcycles Jawa 42 Bobber Black Mirror (Classic Heritage) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
